issue.title: Build Prepare for Offline Screen Storage Management
issue.body: As translators accumulate downloaded resources across multiple projects, device storage fills up. This section of the Prepare for Offline screen gives translators visibility into what is on their device and lets them free space by deleting resources from other projects. It sits below the download controls and is intentionally subordinate to them visually. This ticket is independent of the chapter selection, tier selection, and download control tickets and can be built in parallel. ## Functional Requirements ### Storage Summary - Display a "Manage Device Storage" section label at the top of this section. - Show available device storage and total space currently used by Fluent resources below the label. ### Project Accordions - List downloaded resources from other projects as collapsible accordions, one per project, collapsed by default. - Each accordion header displays the project name, total downloaded size for that project, and a `li:chevron-up` (expanded) / `li:chevron-down` (collapsed) toggle. - Expanding an accordion reveals the individual downloaded resources for that project. - Each item displays a circular selector, content description (e.g., book name and tier), and file size. - Tapping a circular selector selects it for deletion; any number of items across any number of projects can be selected simultaneously. ### Delete Controls - Display a "Delete Selected" button (`li:trash-2`) and the cumulative space that will be freed together at the bottom of the section. - Update the freed-space counter live as items are checked and unchecked. - The button is inactive when no items are selected. - Tapping "Delete Selected" shows a confirmation dialog before executing. - Dialog title: "Delete selected resources?" - Dialog message: "These files will be removed from your device. You'll need to re-download them if needed later." - Dialog actions: "Delete" (confirms, destructive) and "Cancel" (dismisses). - On confirm, delete all selected items simultaneously. ### Empty State - If no other project resources are stored on the device, display: "No resources from other projects on this device." > **Note:** This section is a secondary action and must not compete visually with the download flow above it. --- ## Engineering context *(Added for implementation readiness. Product requirements above remain the source of truth.)* ### Product intent (summary) On Prepare for Offline, show device storage used by Fluent resources and let translators delete resources from **other** projects to free space. ### Proposed technical approach 1. Add a subordinate “Manage Device Storage” section below download controls on `PrepareForOfflineScreen`. 2. Inventory on-disk resources grouped by `project_id` (shared layout with #51 download storage). 3. Use `expo-file-system` (or OS free-space APIs) for available space + summed Fluent usage. 4. Multi-select across project accordions; confirm then delete files + DB inventory rows in one transaction. 5. Exclude the **current** project’s resources from deletion lists (other projects only). ### Systems / modules / anchors - Screen: `src/app/screens/PrepareForOfflineScreen.tsx` - Storage inventory: new module under `src/services/` + queries on download inventory table - Types: `src/types/prepareOffline/types.ts` - Nav params already include `projectId` for “current project” ### Implementation steps 1. Agree path layout + inventory schema with #51 (blocker if #51 has not defined storage). 2. Build storage summary (available + Fluent used). 3. Build other-project accordions + multi-select + live “space to free”. 4. Confirmation dialog copy exactly as specified; delete selected. 5. Empty state when no other-project resources. 6. Tests for inventory grouping, disable Delete with empty selection, delete transaction. ### Dependencies & prerequisites - **In-repo:** Can UI-scaffold in parallel, but **real delete** needs #51 storage/inventory. Soft-depends on #52 only for layout stacking. - **External:** None beyond files already downloaded via mobile. ### Edge cases & failure states - Delete while download active for another project: block or cancel those queue items first. - Partial delete failure: report which items failed; refresh inventory. - Available space APIs differ by Android version — degrade gracefully. - Do not allow deleting the active project’s required Tier 1 from this section (section is other-projects only). ### Testing & verification - Unit: inventory aggregation + selection totals. - Manual Android: delete frees space; empty state; confirm/cancel dialogs. - Device QA required (filesystem). ### Analytics / observability / migrations - Inventory table migrations coordinated with #51. - Log deleted counts/bytes per project id. ### Assumptions - “Other projects” = all inventoried projects except the Prepare for Offline `projectId` in context. - Product copy strings are final. ### Open questions 1. Are Settings-only visits without `projectId` (picker flow) treating “current” as the picked project only after selection? 2. Should deleting resources also clear related SQLite cached texts, or only downloaded media files? ### Acceptance criteria - [ ] Section shows available device storage and total Fluent resource usage. - [ ] Other projects listed as collapsed accordions with name + size; expand shows selectable items. - [ ] Delete Selected inactive with none selected; live freed-space counter while selecting. - [ ] Confirm dialog uses specified title/message/actions; confirm deletes all selected. - [ ] Empty state copy shown when no other-project resources. - [ ] Section remains visually subordinate to the download flow. - [ ] Filesystem delete verified on Android device QA.

**Implement with:** Local filesystem + DB inventory only. No mock API needed for this ticket’s core AC.
